Name: JP's Farms - Sea and Ocean Farm - Big Expanded Farm
Author: juanpa98ar
Description:
[font=Georgia][b][i][color=#00ffff][size=6][u][center]﻿[/center][center]﻿Water Farm[/center][/u][/size][/color][/i][/b]

[color=#ff7700][b][i][size=6][u]Map features:[/u][/size]
[/i][/b][/color]
[/font][font=Georgia][color=#ff0000][size=4][b][i]
[/i][/b][/size][/color][/font][list]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Part of the farm is connected by stone paths in the shallow water and in the deep water there are lotus paths connecting several paths (real life lotuses can't hold the weight of a person, don't even try).[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[/list][list]
[*][b][i][font=Georgia][size=4]Several buildings were relocated to small islands and beautiful decorations were added.[/size][/font][/i][/b]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][b][i]You will be able to access new locations the further you progress in the game. Several paths are blocked by fallen logs or meteorites, so you will have to upgrade your tools to make your way through. [/i][/b][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][color=#f4f4f4][size=4][i][b]Several teleportation points will take you in a jiffy to the corresponding islands. There will be signs indicating where each one goes. [/b][/i][/size][/color][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i][color=#ffff00]Unlock new islands as you progress through the game![/color][/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Every day new resources will be generated on each island. [/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Two maps are available, "Sea Farm" and "Ocean Farm". [/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]A much larger maps than the original standard map. (220x220 vs 110x110 vs Original 80x65).[/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]"Ocean Farm" has twice as much space plus a battle arena where you can face powerful monsters on a daily basis. [/i][/b][/size][/font]
[*][font=Georgia][size=4][b][i]Maps ready to be traveled even on your horse![/i][/b][/size][/font]
[/list][font=Georgia]
[/font][font=Georgia]

[color=#ffff00][size=6][i][b][u]Instructions:[/u][/b][/i][/size][/color]
[color=#f4f4f4][size=3][b][i]Once downloaded, unzip and move the obtained folders directly to the Mods folder of the game.
[/i][/b][/size][/color][color=#ffff00][size=4][b][i]This map requires another mods to work, you will see it in the 'Requirements' section or when downloading the mod.[/i][/b][/size][/color]

Deprecated:
[b][size=4][i][color=#00ffff]If you were using the CP version of this map[/color], you must now do the following:
[/i][/size][size=4][i]Load your game and before leaving the house go to Smapi and copy and paste this:
"[/i][/size][size=4][i][color=#00ff00]set_farm_type Juanpa98ar.SeaFarm/SeaFarm[/color]". Without quotation marks. This will return the map without major problems. [/i][/size]

[color=#ff0000][size=5][i]For the moment that's all. Report if any kind of bug occurs and comment if you have any idea to add to the map.[/i][/size][/color][/b][/font]
